## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Related issue

Link the related issue or discussion, for example `Closes #123`.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. If a check was not run, explain why.

## Screenshots

Include screenshots or recordings for user-interface changes, or write "Not applicable."

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated modifications.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated where appropriate.
- [ ] Documentation was updated for user-visible or operational changes.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private URLs, or other sensitive data were added.
- [ ] Breaking changes and migration steps are clearly documented.
- [ ] I have read and followed `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`.
